title: One-step span bound
statement: Let $A,Q$ be types, let $x$ be a finite word over $A$, let $M$ be a one-work-tape Turing machine, and let $c,d$ be configurations. If one step of $M$ takes $c$ to $d$, and the work-head positions in both $c$ and $d$ lie between integers $lo$ and $hi$, then the run from $c$ for one step reaches $d$ and its work-head position at every time up to and including that step lies between $lo$ and $hi$.
hypotheses_covered: $A,Q$ are types and $x$ is a finite word over $A$.
$M$ is a one-work-tape Turing machine; $c,d$ are configurations.
The work-head position in $c$ lies in $[lo,hi]$.
The work-head position in $d$ lies in $[lo,hi]$.
